description: size-optimized fx2-cmix fork with a second structural top-layer mixer keyed by MediaWiki column/numeric state and blended at 1/16 with the global top mixer
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Built from external/fx2-cmix with GCC using SEED=923, UPDATE_LIMIT=3000, FX2_STRUCT_TOP_MIXER, FX2_STRUCT_TOP_MIXER_WEIGHT=16, FX2_STRUCT_TOP_MIXER_CONTEXT=6, all objects compiled with -Os and link-time optimization enabled. cmix.bin.gz and english.dic.gz are counted by the harness.

10m_prefix_direct_o3.verdict: pruned as an archive-only O3 candidate

250k_context7_hot_field_prev_class.verdict: pruned; archive worsened versus context6 and binary grew

1m_context6_extra5_avg_os.verdict: pruned; tiny archive win does not pay for the extra top-context binary bytes

250k_context6_wrt_direct_m13_lto.verdict: pruned as exact candidate; archive saved 45 bytes but binary grew 162 bytes

1m_context6_w20_lto_os.verdict: pruned; changing the structural top-mixer blend from weight 16 to 20 worsened the 1MB archive and grew the LTO package

1m_context6_wrt_direct_m13_os.verdict: archive diagnostic only; archive saved 68 bytes versus context6 LTO but non-LTO binary overhead dominated

250k_context6_expert_gate_d14_c8_m0_b2.verdict: pruned; aggressive learned selector destabilized the mixer

250k_context6_fxcm_template_pos_lto.verdict: pruned; archive saved 1 byte but binary grew 154 bytes

1m_prefix_direct_no_top_size_control.verdict: archive worsened but exact S won by 18 bytes at 1MB; promoted to 10MB control

10m_prefix_direct_no_top_size_control.verdict: pruned; top-mixer size build wins exact S by 16 bytes at 10MB

verdict: Promote the context-6 top-mixer LTO size build. The top-mixer archive effect is small and O3 10MB regressed, but the size build cuts counted program size enough to create a large exact-S win. Context 6 beats the original field/slot top selector by 3 bytes at 1MB and 7 bytes at 10MB; LTO then preserves the 250K archive, improves the 1MB archive by 1 byte, and cuts counted program size by 6311 bytes. Follow-up hotspot selectors, extra top-context fusion, WRT-direct fusion, structural weight-20 blending, native fxcm template-position context, and tuned expert gating did not produce an exact-score improvement.
